name: Frank's Opera Vol. 1: Waters of March
source:
Frank Dubois is the hottest lad in town. He's also the strongest, the smartest, and the most fascinating. After all, there’s literally no one else like him, since he’s the only teenage boy left in Villa Ñoco.

Like it or not, his favourite neighbors, Amy and Jenny, don’t have more options when it comes to guys their age. And Frank? Well... he’s convinced: it’s only a matter of time before the three of them end up together.

Until then, he spends his days sketching wild fantasies in his notebooks… 

[From [url=https://ropoductions.itch.io/franks-opera]itch.io[/url]]

A spinoff of [url=https://ropoductions.itch.io/final-orginity]FINAL ORGINITY[/url]
